Born in 2025. Two sisters, one vision

Our Story

A vision born
from two sisters
and one dream.

Our story began with two sisters, Paola and Beatriz, one a creative entrepreneur and the other a yoga teacher with a deep passion for wellness and human connection.

In 2025, we launched our very first event, not just a class, but a space where people could move, discover new places, meet inspiring people and feel part of something real.

Every event we create is an invitation to pause, breathe and remember why feeling good matters. Come as you are. Leave as part of our community. A space where people could move, discover new places, meet inspiring people and feel part of something real.

What makes us special

Why Choose Us

We believe wellness should feel like an experience, not a chore. Here's what sets every event apart.

◇

A community you will want to be part of

Every event is designed for you to meet inspiring people, feel at home and leave with much more than just a great workout.

◇

Personal approach

Every experience adapts to your body and needs.

◇

Calm, nature-inspired atmosphere

Designed to help you slow down and reset.

◇

Certified, experienced instructors

Passionate professionals bringing expertise, warmth and energy to every class.
